squads.title: GW6 Wildcard — this season's form + the next six fixtures
squads.description: Built for a Wildcard now, not for GW1: points per 90 this season (anchored to last season so five hot games don't outweigh a proven record), the fixtures from GW6–GW11 (home games weighted up), and how reliably each player has started. Anyone FPL flags as injured, suspended or under 75% to play is left out. Spends the full £100m.
squads.rules: £100m, max 3 per club. Picks maximise expected points: this-season pts/90 blended with last season's (equal weight after five full games, this season taking over as minutes build) × fixture factor for GW6–GW11 × share of minutes played. Starters need 3+ starts this season and composite ≥ 0.55. No ownership filter.

gates: ≥ 10 starts in 25/26 or 24/25 (starters only; bench relaxes)
method.formation: 15 players (2 GKP + 5 DEF + 5 MID + 3 FWD). Starting XI: 1 GKP + 3-5 DEF + 2-5 MID + 2-3 FWD (2 forward minimum, always).

uncalibratedAssumptions.name: Shrinkage anchor
uncalibratedAssumptions.note: Small-sample PPG pulled toward this low anchor. Direction principled; exact percentile fitted post-hoc. Will be calibrated against GW1-6 returns.

uncalibratedAssumptions.name: Shrinkage weight curve
uncalibratedAssumptions.note: Squared curve so small samples climb slowly. Fitted alongside anchor. Will be calibrated.

uncalibratedAssumptions.name: EU rotation penalty (UCL / UEL / UECL)
uncalibratedAssumptions.note: Differentiated by midweek load. No pre-season data to calibrate; will be revisited after clubs' first EU games.

uncalibratedAssumptions.name: Composite quality floor
uncalibratedAssumptions.note: Prevents crowd from forcing a genuinely poor pick. Same floor across all four squads for method-symmetry.

rulesRecap: Only the highest-owned keeper at each club may start; bench keeper always in the cheapest tier (£4.0-£4.5m). At that price, ownership signals the crowd's chosen enabler — Dubravka at 24.8% wins on that tiebreak.
No bench player costs more than a starter at the same position

Composite = 45% proven output + 35% opening fixtures + 20% minutes security. Minutes security uses CURRENT (2025/26) season only — promoted-club players and summer signings from overseas score zero and are bench-only.

Reserve deliberately holds £8m for early-season transfers. Differentials naturally banks around £7m: under the ≤ 12% ownership cap and minutes-security floor, the eligible pool has no better use for the extra spend. Template and Balanced spend the full £100m.
limitations: Minutes security is measured across the whole of last season. A player who won his place late in the campaign may be under-rated here.
"First-choice" at each club is inferred from ownership, not from playing time in the final weeks of last season. A late-season shirt-winner may be flagged as backup.
Pre-season friendlies, injury noise below 25% chance-of-playing, in-season rotation patterns, set-piece taker changes announced after the daily snapshot — none of these are visible to us.
Player-vs-specific-opponent history is not on the cards — median sample per pair from one season is 2 fixtures, too thin to publish as a fact-anchored claim.
